title: Unisex Alien – Visiting. Not Impressed. Embroidered Zip Hoodie
who: the person who has seen the planet and is not impressed, zipped on for a desert road trip, a convention and the walk home from a very long meeting.
art: A grumpy teal alien with arms crossed leans on a flying saucer parked beside a desert shack and a cactus under a crescent moon, in teal, coral and cream with a worn print texture.
headline: VISITING.
inks: gold and cream on Black and Navy, ochre and navy on Ash
chest: a small flying saucer with legs and a row of lights
warm2: cold desert nights, windy road trips and long waits at the airport
gift_line: for the friend who rolls their eyes at every first contact scene.
seo_desc: An alien zip up hoodie: VISITING. NOT IMPRESSED. on the back over an unimpressed alien and its saucer, plus an embroidered flying saucer on the chest.
